classification: selective adaptation of history semantics; new strict observation interface

source.identity_note: Extracted Docker source; not claimed to be a Git descendant of the frozen legacy repository.

retained_policy: Interpolate only between already observed records with gap at most 0.11 seconds
Missing history is explicit; no nearest-neighbour fill or repeated-current pose
changes: Standalone standard-library interface, without CARLA or model imports
Strict numbers reject bool, string, NaN and infinity
Explicit episode reset replaces implicit reset on time rollback
Monotonic observation, receipt and query clocks
Latest-frame duplicate is idempotent and cannot refresh sensor age
Unknown or expired observation cannot be consumed as free space
Shortest-angle yaw interpolation; motion history never fabricates obstacle state
